# SRL Recovery

> SRL Recovery is a locally-owned, 24/7 breakdown and accident recovery service based in Cleland, near Motherwell, Scotland, covering Glasgow and the wider Lanarkshire and Renfrewshire area. No call centres. The person who answers the phone dispatches the truck.

SRL Recovery operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year, with no out-of-hours or holiday surcharges. Average arrival time is 30–45 minutes across the core coverage area. Contact: 01698 700970, enquiries@srlrecovery.com. Website: https://srlrecovery.com

## Pricing

- Local recovery: from £60 call-out + £1.50 per mile (plus VAT)
- Motorway / live-lane recovery: £120 flat call-out + £1.50 per mile (plus VAT)
- Winch fee: £40 (only if the vehicle needs winching)
- Skate fee: £40 (only if the vehicle is immobilised)
- Prices are the same day or night, with no out-of-hours, weekend, or holiday surcharges
- A clear final price is confirmed by phone before dispatch

## Services

24/7 breakdown recovery, emergency breakdown recovery, quick car recovery, car recovery near me, van recovery, commercial and trade recovery, motorbike recovery, 4x4 recovery, classic and prestige car recovery, accident recovery (fault and non-fault), motorway and live-lane recovery, roadside assistance, insurance recovery, vehicle transport, and scrap car collection. No membership or breakdown cover subscription required, pay-as-you-go.

## Areas covered

Glasgow, Paisley, East Kilbride, Motherwell, Hamilton, Clydebank, Coatbridge, Bearsden, Rutherglen, Cambuslang, Bellshill, Dumbarton, Wishaw, Airdrie, Cumbernauld, Kirkintilloch, Bishopbriggs, Uddingston, Newton Mearns, Barrhead, Renfrew, Johnstone, Blantyre, Larkhall, Carluke, Giffnock, and Abington.

## Motorways covered

M8, M73, M74, M77, and M80, including live-lane and hard-shoulder recovery.

## Non-fault accident claims

SRL Recovery manages non-fault accident claims start to finish at zero upfront cost: free recovery, a replacement hire car within 24 hours, and full claim handling. Average settlement is around £3,000 per non-fault customer.
